register.labelZh: PAINT 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: paint over 可以表示用一層新油漆蓋住污漬、刮痕或不想保留的顏色。；當名稱、數字、線條、標誌或其他標記被油漆完全遮住時,可以使用 paint out。；paint up 可以描述把房屋、房間、店舖、船隻或其他地方重新髹得明亮鮮艷。；這些表達可以出現在關於裝修、維修、告示、道路、店舖、車輛和建築物的對話中。
register.summaryEn: Paint over helps you explain that a new layer of paint covers stains, scratches or an unwanted colour. Paint out is useful when a name, number, line, logo or other marking is covered so that people cannot see it. Paint up can describe making a house, room, shop, boat or other place look fresh and colourful. These expressions can appear in conversations about decorating, repairs, signs, roads, shops, vehicles and buildings.

fixedVariable.variableEn: Do not expect the PAINT expression to appear in the same place every time. It may follow will or to, appear in a question, or be used like this: We will paint over the marks. The old number was painted out. They decided to paint the house up. When using it or them, place the word as shown: paint over it paint it out paint it up Notice the difference: paint over dirty marks or an old colour paint words, numbers or markings out paint a house, room or shop up in bright colours
